channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Church news: Churches plan weekly and special services
item.description: Wilson-area churches announce upcoming worship services, pastor anniversary events and a community food giveaway.

item.title: Public hearing to decide $52M in J&J incentives
item.description: County and city officials will hold a public hearing on Jan. 29 on more than $52 million in incentives for Johnson & Johnson’s new drug manufacturing plant. The new plant will be Johnson & Johnson's second investment in Wilson.

item.title: Our Opinion: MLK's dream should convict, challenge and unite us
item.description: An editorial reflects on MLK’s “I Have a Dream” legacy from Rocky Mount to Washington, urging Americans to confront ongoing racial injustice while embracing a shared, unifying patriotism.

item.title: Greenland? Really?
item.description: An emeritus political scientist argues Trump's push to seize Greenland — despite existing U.S. base rights, dubious Russia-China claims and overwhelming local opposition — reflects imperial ambition, not genuine security needs.

item.title: What SCOTUS decision on girls’ sports might mean for NC
item.description: Supreme Court justices signaled support for Idaho and West Virginia laws limiting transgender girls’ participation in female sports, a potential ruling that could strengthen North Carolina’s similar law and curb new Title IX mandates.

item.title: Dr. King’s warnings seem more prescient than ever
item.description: Martin Luther King’s 1967 warning about racism, materialism and militarism frames a new report on rising Black unemployment and federal policies that dismantle civil rights and deepen economic inequality.

item.title: Community briefs: Variety of events planned for coming weeks
item.description: Upcoming Wilson events include a church food giveaway, GOP social, library book donation drop-off, free tax prep assistance, Bible college registration and a pancake dinner.

item.title: Application process begins for 3 public housing communities
item.description: Wilson Housing Authority opens waiting lists Feb. 3 for all units at Whitfield, Forrest Road and E.B. Jordan Homes, with preference for veterans, homeless households and domestic violence victims.

item.title: ‘We speak as living descendants’: Vick Cemetery concerns dominate city council’s public comment
item.description: Descendants of those buried at Wilson’s historic Vick Cemetery questioned city leaders over damaged grave markers, secrecy around decisions and called for expanded radar surveys during Thursday night's Wilson City Council meeting.

item.title: Knight’s appeal to be heard Tuesday morning
item.description: N.C. State Board of Elections will hear Wilson County sheriff candidate Bobby Knight’s appeal of his disqualification in a special virtual meeting Tuesday at 11:30 a.m.
